WITH policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        pa.Effective_Date,
        pa.Policy_Amount
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN policy p ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336

    Effective_Date,
    Policy_Amount AS Annual_Premium,
    ROUND(
        (Policy_Amount - LAG(Policy_Amount) OVER (ORDER BY Effective_Date)) * 100.0 / LAG(Policy_Amount) OVER (ORDER BY Effective_Date),
        2
    ) AS Percentage_Change
FROM policy_premiums

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '0-5 miles'
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 miles'
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '11-15 miles'

    END AS Distance_Band,
    COUNT(*) AS Number_of_Claims,
    AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS Average_Loss_Ratio
FROM fire_claim
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '0-5 miles'
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 miles'
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '11-15 miles'
        ELSE 'More than 15 miles'
    END
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 1
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 2
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END;

WITH policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        pa.Effective_Date,
        pa.Policy_Amount
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium p ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN policy pol ON pa.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
    WHERE pol.Policy_Number = 31003000336
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Effective_Date,
        Policy_Amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Effective_Date ASC) AS rn_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Effective_Date DESC) AS rn_desc
    FROM policy_premiums
),
first_and_last AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN Effective_Date END) AS first_date,
        MIN(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN Policy_Amount END) AS first_amount,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN Effective_Date END) AS last_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN Policy_Amount END) AS last_amount
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT
    POWER(
        last_amount / first_amount,
        1.0 / (
            (YEAR(last_date) - YEAR(first_date))
            + (MONTH(last_date) - MONTH(first_date)) / 12.0
            + (DAY(last_date) - DAY(first_date)) / 365.0
        )
    ) - 1 AS compound_annual_growth_rate
FROM first_and_last;

SELECT 
    Number_of_Firefighters,
    AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS Average_Loss_Ratio
FROM 
    fire_claim
GROUP BY 
    Number_of_Firefighters
ORDER BY 
    Average_Loss_Ratio ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH fire_claims AS (
    SELECT 
        Loss_Ratio,
        CASE 
            WHEN Year_Built >= 2000 THEN '2000_or_later'
            ELSE 'before_2000'
        END AS era
    FROM fire_claim
    WHERE Year_Built IS NOT NULL
),
era_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        era,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY Loss_Ratio) AS median_loss_ratio
    FROM fire_claims
    GROUP BY era
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT median_loss_ratio FROM era_stats WHERE era = '2000_or_later') AS median_2000_or_later,
    (SELECT median_loss_ratio FROM era_stats WHERE era = 'before_2000') AS median_before_2000;

WITH loss_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_losses
    FROM claim_amount ca
    JOIN claim c ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date >= '2019-01-01' 
      AND c.Claim_Open_Date < '2020-01-01'
      AND (
          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment lp WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
          OR
          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve lr WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
      )
),
premium_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium p ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    WHERE pa.Effective_Date >= '2019-01-01' 
      AND pa.Effective_Date < '2020-01-01'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN p.total_premium = 0 OR p.total_premium IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE l.total_losses / p.total_premium
    END AS loss_ratio
FROM loss_2019 l
CROSS JOIN premium_2019 p;

SELECT 
    c.Claim_Identifier AS claim_number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_loss,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_expense,
    CASE 
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
              COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0)) = 0 
        THEN 0
        ELSE (
            (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
             COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100.0 /
            (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
             COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0))
        )
    END AS expense_percentage
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN catastrophe cat ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amount ca ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier

answer.sql:
WITH policy_coverage_claims AS (
    SELECT
        p.Policy_Number,
        pcd.Effective_Date AS Coverage_Start_Date,
        pa.Policy_Amount AS Premium,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ca.Amount_Type_Code = 'LOSS_PAYMENT' THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payments,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ca.Amount_Type_Code = 'LOSS_RESERVE' THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserves
    FROM
        policy p
    JOIN
        policy_coverage_detail pcd ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN
        policy_amount pa ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN
        claim_coverage cc ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN
        claim c ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN
        claim_amount ca ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE
        ca.Amount_Type_Code IN ('LOSS_PAYMENT', 'LOSS_RESERVE')
    GROUP BY
        p.Policy_Number,
        pcd.Effective_Date,
        pa.Policy_Amount
)
SELECT
    Policy_Number,
    Coverage_Start_Date,
    Premium,
    Loss_Payments + Loss_Reserves AS Incurred_Loss,
    (Loss_Payments + Loss_Reserves) / Premium AS Loss_Ratio
FROM
    policy_coverage_claims
WHERE
    Premium > 0;

    policy pol ON a.Product_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN

LEFT JOIN 
    policy_coverage_detail pcd ON pol.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN

LEFT JOIN 
    claim c ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN 
    claim_amount ca ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN 
    loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    p.First_Name,
    p.Last_Name;

WITH claim_costs AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_cost
    FROM claim c
    JOIN claim_amount ca ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
    )
    GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_days AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        DATEDIFF('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) AS days_open
    FROM claim c
    WHERE c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
),
claim_zip AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        la.Postal_Code AS zip_code
    FROM claim c
    JOIN insurable_object io ON c.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    JOIN geographic_location gl ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
    JOIN location_address la ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
)
SELECT 
    cz.zip_code,
    SUM(cc.total_cost) AS total_claim_cost,
    AVG(cd.days_open) AS avg_days_open
FROM claim_zip cz
JOIN claim_costs cc ON cz.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN claim_days cd ON cz.Claim_Identifier = cd.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY cz.zip_code
ORDER BY cz.zip_code;

        a.End_Date AS assessment_end_date
    FROM assessment_result ar
    JOIN assessment a ON ar.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM underwriting_assessment ua
        WHERE ua.Assessment_Result_Identifier = ar.Assessment_Result_Identifier
    )
),
policy_assessment AS (
    SELECT
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number,
        p.Effective_Date AS policy_effective_date,
        uad.assessment_end_date,
        uad.Assessment_Result_Type_Code,
        ap.Party_Identifier
    FROM policy p
    JOIN agreement a ON p.Policy_Identifier = a.Product_Identifier
    JOIN agreement_assessment aa ON a.Agreement_Type_Code = aa.Assessment_Identifier
    JOIN underwriting_assessment_dates uad ON aa.Assessment_Identifier = uad.Assessment_Identifier
    JOIN agreement_party_role ap ON a.Agreement_Type_Code = ap.Agreement_Identifier
    WHERE ap.Party_Role_Code = 'UNDERWRITER'
)
SELECT
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    pa.Policy_Number,
    DATEDIFF('day', pa.assessment_end_date, pa.policy_effective_date) AS days_between,
    p.First_Name,
    p.Last_Name,
    pa.Assessment_Result_Type_Code
FROM policy_assessment pa
JOIN party pt ON pa.Party_Identifier = pt.Party_Identifier
JOIN person p ON pt.Party_Identifier = p.Person_Identifier;

answer.sql:
SELECT 
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_loss_paid,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_loss_reserved,
    CASE 
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) + 
              COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0)) = 0 
        THEN 0 
        ELSE (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100.0) / 
             (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) + 
              COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0))
    END AS paid_share_of_incurred_loss_percentage
FROM catastrophe c
JOIN claim cl ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cl.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN claim_amount ca ON cl.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Catastrophe_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Catastrophe_Identifier;

answer.sql:
WITH property_claims AS (
    SELECT
        la.Line_1_Address AS street_address,
        SUM(COALESCE(la.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS incurred_loss
    FROM claim c
    JOIN claim_amount ca ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN insurable_object io ON c.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    JOIN geographic_location gl ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
    JOIN location_address la ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    )
    GROUP BY la.Line_1_Address
),
property_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        la.Line_1_Address AS street_address,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS total_premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN insurable_object io ON pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    JOIN geographic_location gl ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
    JOIN location_address la ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
    WHERE pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Policy_Amount_Identifier FROM premium
    )
    GROUP BY la.Line_1_Address
)
SELECT
    pc.street_address,
    pc.incurred_loss / pp.total_premium AS loss_to_premium_ratio
FROM property_claims pc
JOIN property_premiums pp ON pc.street_address = pp.street_address
ORDER BY loss_to_premium_ratio DESC;
